source: guide
audience: vendor
title: Vendor portal guide
---

## How do I create a vendor account and sign in?

On the vendor sign-in page choose "New restaurant? Sign up". Enter your full name, restaurant name, pick your cuisines, enter the restaurant latitude and longitude, then an email and a password of at least 6 characters, and choose Sign up. To sign in later, enter email and password and choose Log in. An administrator can also create a vendor account for you.

## Why is my new restaurant closed?

A new restaurant starts closed, so customers cannot order yet. Add your menu, then open it from the Dashboard.

## How do I open or close my restaurant?

1. Open Dashboard in the left menu.
2. Under Restaurant status, choose "Open restaurant" or "Close restaurant".

The left menu also shows an Open or Closed badge. Customers cannot check out while the restaurant is closed.

## Why can I not open my restaurant?

The message "Add at least one available menu item before opening" appears when no menu item is marked available. Add an item or mark one available on the Menu page, then try again. An administrator can also pause a restaurant, which keeps it closed until they unsuspend it.

## How do I set the delivery fee and promo text?

1. Open Dashboard and find Delivery settings.
2. Enter the Delivery fee in rupees (0 or more). Customers see it on your store card, in their cart and at checkout, and it is added to their total.
3. Optionally enter Promo text, such as an offer line. It is shown on your card as a label and does not change the customer's total.
4. Choose Save. The message "Saved." appears.

## How do I add a menu item?

1. Open Menu in the left menu.
2. Enter the Item name and Price (rupees, above zero). An image link is optional.
3. Choose Add item.

The add form takes only these fields. Add the description, category and vegetarian marking afterwards with Edit on the item's row.

## How do I edit, hide or delete a menu item?

In the Menu table each item has these buttons: Edit (name, description, category, veg, price, image), "Mark unavailable" or "Mark available", and Delete. An unavailable item cannot be ordered. Delete is refused for an item that has past orders, with the message "This item has past orders — mark it unavailable instead of deleting it." Use "Mark unavailable" for those items.

## How do I add choices like size or toppings to an item?

Choose Options on the item's row. Add an option group with a name and the minimum and maximum number of choices a customer may pick, then add options to the group, each with a name and an extra price (0 or more). Delete removes a group or an option.

## How do I handle incoming orders?

Open Orders. The board has four columns: New, Accepted, Preparing and Ready, and it refreshes every 10 seconds. On each card choose the next-step button: Accept order, then Start preparing, then Mark ready. Full details opens the whole order.

## Can I reject or cancel an order?

You can Reject an order only while it is in New (still Placed). The customer then sees it as Rejected and the payment is marked refunded. Once accepted, an order cannot be rejected or cancelled by the store.

## What happens after I mark an order Ready?

A delivery partner is assigned automatically, normally within seconds, and picks the order up. You do not mark orders as delivered.

## Why does an order say its payment is still processing?

Right after checkout the simulated payment can take a few seconds to resolve. You see "Order payment is still processing — try again in a moment". Wait briefly and try again.

## How do I reset my password or sign out?

In the left menu, your name is shown with a Reset password link that emails a reset link to your account address. Sign out is at the bottom of the menu.

## Where do I see customer reviews of my store?

Open Reviews in the left menu. It lists reviews of your store, newest first, with the customer's first name and last initial, stars, comment, photo and dish ratings. Tabs filter by All, Needs reply and Reported, and a badge shows how many reviews still need a reply. You do not see delivery ratings or comments about the delivery partner.

## How do I reply to a review?

On the Reviews page type your reply (up to 600 characters) under the review and choose Reply. A review has one reply from the store. To change it, type the new text and choose Update reply; Remove deletes it. The customer and other shoppers see your reply under the review on the store page.

## Can I hide or delete a review of my store?

No. Vendors cannot hide or delete reviews. If a review is abusive, fake or not about your store, choose "Report to admin" on it; an administrator decides whether to hide it. A review hidden by the team shows only as a note with its date.
